newsitem.title: USA: ABN AMRO takeover of ChiCorp cleared by Fed.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO takeover of ChiCorp cleared by Fed.

text.p: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday approved a proposal by ABN AMRO Holding N.V. of the Netherlands to acquire all the voting shares of ChiCorp Inc of Chicago and to engage in nonbanking activities including underwriting and dealing in debt and equity securities.
ABN AMRO is the largest bank in the Netherlands with total assets of $339.4 billion. ChiCorp engages world wide in investment advisory, securities underwriting and futures-related activities.

ABN AMRO will merge a ChiCorp subsdiary and an existing subsidiary, ABN AMRO Securities (USA) Inc. The new company will continue to be broker-dealers registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission and other regulatory bodies.
